title: MMP Cognitive Memory Block (§8.2 Record Model)
description: The two-section record. `fields` carries the CAT7 content; `metadata` carries every provable fact about the record — its address, author, time, audience and descent. The split is normative: the address is a function of the categories alone (§8.2.3), so identical observations from different nodes collapse to one address.

categories.description: The CAT7 container. Seven categories, each carrying `text`. The wire key and the prose term are the same word. Its key name never enters an address or signature preimage.

text.description: Mood keyword (MUST). Mood contributes its TEXT ONLY to any preimage — valence and arousal are excluded, so no preimage contains a floating-point number.

valence.description: RECOMMENDED when the agent has reliable circumplex data. Not part of any preimage.

arousal.description: RECOMMENDED when the agent has reliable circumplex data. Not part of any preimage.

metadata.description: Provable facts about the record (§8.2.1 Two-section record).

key.description: Content address (§8.2.3): `cmb-` followed by exactly 64 lowercase hex characters. The digest is a promote-odd Merkle root over the seven per-category keys — NOT a hash of a concatenated preimage. A key is valid iff it matches this form; implementations MUST reject anything else rather than attempt a legacy interpretation.

createdBy.description: The authoring node identity; bound by the signature (§8.2.4).

createdTimestamp.description: Milliseconds since epoch — the AUTHOR'S own, never a receiver-local timestamp; bound by the signature (§8.2.4).

room.description: Audience boundary. Signed (§8.2.4), so a signature is valid only for the room it was made for.

to.description: Directed recipient, or null for a broadcast. Signed (§8.2.4) — this is what stops a directed record being replayed as a broadcast.

lineage.description: Descent; null for a root record.

parents.description: Direct parent CMB keys. A SET: sorted bytewise before framing, so order cannot change the signed bytes.

sig.description: base64url Ed25519 signature over the §8.2.4 payload (domain tag `mmp-sig-v2`). SHOULD be present; a receiver holding the author's key MUST verify it.

sigAlg.description: Signature algorithm; a verifier MUST pin this rather than trust the field.

_e2e.description: Present only when the container is E2E-encrypted in transit (§18.2.1): then `categories` is a ciphertext string rather than the object above.

tether.description: Optional §15.8 tether attestation carried on a stored or re-emitted remix.

text.description: The category's content. TEXT IS THE NORMATIVE CONTENT — an embedding vector is receiver-local and MUST NOT be emitted in a record (§9.2.1): a foreign vector is not comparable in the receiver's own encoder, so a receiver re-encodes from text and never uses a transmitted vector for admission.
